defect: Weird 'refreshment' (flicker) when entering two incorrect logins in a row.
hypothesis: The error banner was wrapped in Reveal, so it carried the scroll-reveal .reveal/.in classes plus a data-shown display:none toggle. On the second submit setError('') set display:none (abrupt blink-off) and, when the next error resolved, it snapped back on already-in (no fade) — an inconsistent, jarring hard blink-off/blink-on between the two failures.
